== Decklist checked against the scan (2026-10-16) ==
Transcribed from the scanned sheet (Day 2 PDF page 106). The sheet's player name is '''Tom Frafjord''' (deck title ''TTO'', Worlds Day 2, 10/11/08). The page moved from [[2008 Worlds Day 2 Ian Westergaard DS Endor Operations]]. The entry above that calls it Ian Westergaard's sheet is a misreading. The Day 2 PDF has no sheet for Ian Westergaard. The old list was a copy of Jesse Reynolds' list; this one is Tom's sheet. Leave Them To Me (V) was not on the sheet.
